The Salon

We started in Des Moines. We grew up on the lake.

Catwalk opened in Des Moines, Washington, and now sits above Lakeland Hills, across from Lake Tapps.

We work hard to be a fun group of professional hair experts. We attend and host continuing-education classes regularly and follow the trends in the beauty industry, because the whole salon is education-driven — we host a lot of future professionals and rising stars for exactly that reason.

Catwalk is an assortment of independent contractors and house stylists, so no two chairs are quite the same. What is the same is the standard: an unparalleled level of customer service, and a large shelf of professional product and tools so you can get the look at home too. We show up for community events and local schools around the plateau, and we'll special-order anything a guest is looking for.

Book a chair

Three steps and you're in the chair.

  1. Call the salon

    Tell us what you want done. If you don't know yet, say that — consultations are free and that's what they're for.

  2. We match you to a stylist

    Every stylist here keeps her own book and her own specialty. We'll put you with the one who does the thing you're asking for.

  3. Show up a few minutes early

    There's a fifteen-minute grace period, and parking right at the door on 9th St E.
